ddl:
CREATE TABLE Role (
    Role_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Role_Name VARCHAR(255)
);

CREATE TABLE Category (
    Category_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Category_Name VARCHAR(255)
);

CREATE TABLE User (
    Contact_Information VARCHAR(255),
    Name VARCHAR(255),
    Role_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    User_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    FOREIGN KEY (Role_ID) REFERENCES Role(Role_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Question (
    Category_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Content VARCHAR(255),
    Correct_Answer VARCHAR(255),
    Difficulty_Level INTEGER,
    Explanation VARCHAR(255),
    Options VARCHAR(255),
    Question_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    FOREIGN KEY (Category_ID) REFERENCES Category(Category_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Exam (
    Creator_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Description VARCHAR(255),
    Exam_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    Exam_Name VARCHAR(255),
    Status VARCHAR(255),
    Time_Range DATETIME,
    FOREIGN KEY (Creator_ID) REFERENCES User(User_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE Exam_Question (
    Exam_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Question_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Sequence VARCHAR(255),
    PRIMARY KEY (Exam_ID, Question_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Exam_ID) REFERENCES Exam(Exam_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Question_ID) REFERENCES Question(Question_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE User_Answer_Sheet (
    Exam_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Score FLOAT,
    Student_ID INTEGER NOT NULL,
    Submission_Time DATETIME,
    PRIMARY KEY (Student_ID, Exam_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Exam_ID) REFERENCES Exam(Exam_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (Student_ID) REFERENCES User(User_ID)
);

The online examination system shall include functions such as user management, question bank management, and exam management.
The system shall have different user roles, such as student, teacher, and administrator. Each user shall have a unique ID, real name, contact information, and other details.
The question bank shall contain various questions. Each question shall have a difficulty level, content, options, correct answer, explanation, and belong to a category.
Administrators shall be able to create exams, set the exam name, description, time range, status, and select questions from the question bank to include in the exam, specifying the order of the questions.
Students shall be able to take exams. After submitting answers, the system shall record the exam score and the answer status for each question, including the user's answer and whether it is correct.
The exam score shall include the student's score and submission time.
